en: Sepia-toned panoramic view over a densely built historic European city with red-tile-style roofs and several Baroque church towers. Dominating the middle-left background is a large Baroque church with twin towers and a central dome, reminiscent of St. Nicholas Church. The foreground shows a sloping area with trees and a large rectangular church or monastery building, looking down toward tightly packed medieval streets.
